verdict.rationale: Navan has its own AI assistants (Ava, Navan Edge), so asking whether they can call external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Navan acting as an MCP server that external assistants such as Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT connect to. Nothing shows Navan itself connecting to or plugging in third-party MCP servers, and server-side evidence does not count toward this client story.
